en.headline: Government to tender Shek Mun site for about 960 private homes
en.dek: The Development Bureau announced the third-quarter land sale programme, saying the first three quarters already exceed the annual private housing supply target of 12,600 units.
body: The Development Bureau said it would put a residential site in Shek Mun, Sha Tin, out to tender this quarter, expected to provide about 960 private homes.

Secretary for Development Bernadette Linn told a briefing that the site, at the junction of Tai Chung Kiu Road and On Sum Street and near Shek Mun MTR station, was originally zoned for commercial use but has been approved for residential development. The successful bidder must set aside a small amount of floor space for a public car park. Linn said the mature community and transport links should attract interest.

Including the Urban Renewal Authority's To Kwa Wan Road project and private redevelopment cases, the quarter is expected to supply about 3,845 units. Combined with the first two quarters, the first three quarters of the financial year would provide about 15,680 units, above the annual target of 12,600. Linn said the target is not a hard ceiling and the government would not slow land sales solely because the number has been reached, noting positive market sentiment.

zh.headline: 政府推售石門住宅地 料提供約960個單位
zh.dek: 發展局公布第三季賣地計劃，推出沙田石門住宅用地，首三季供應已超全年私人房屋目標12600個單位。
body: 發展局表示，本財政年度第三季（10月至12月）將以招標形式推出一幅位於沙田石門大涌橋路與安心街交界的住宅用地，預計可提供約960個私人住宅單位。
發展局局長甮漢豪指，該地皮原屬商業用途，已獲城規會批准改作住宅發展，鄰近港鐵石門站，周邊配套成熟，相信受市場歡迎；中標者須保留少部分樓面作公共停車場。
連同市建局土瓜灣道項目及私人重建換地個案，本季料可供應約3845個單位。首三季合共約15680個單位，已超出全年目標12600個。甮漢豪表示目標並非硬指標，政府不會純粹因數字達標而放慢推地步伐，並留意到市場氣氛向好。
